artifacts.synopsis: Biese and others complained that Tennessee Valley Presbytery erred by approving Redeemer Church session minutes without exception—minutes noting a youth Super Bowl party—and by denying their complaint seeking a Sabbath exception. The SJC denied the complaint: because Presbytery gave no reasons for its actions, the record was insufficient to find it erred in interpreting the Constitution. A concurrence said the denial did not decide the Sabbath merits; a dissent would have held the complaint judicially out of order for lack of SJC jurisdiction over presbytery record review.
